dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Whew... Finally, a chance to put our feet up. Meow!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Here, drink this. It's water with some salt and nectar in it. It makes a great recovery drink after intense exercise.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: The flavor is nicely balanced, with a touch of salt to offset the sweetness. Take a sip, and you'll feel a burst of energy, plus a boost to your mental clarity... Actually, you know what — forget all that. Just try it for yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: I was expecting to see weird and wonderful things in this place. But so far, zilch...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: No funny-looking critters with antennae on their heads, no plants full of funky-smelling juice... Even the monsters here are all ones I've seen before.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: If this carries on... I guess I can forget about trying to find any new cocktail ingredients here.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hero defeats dragon... Princess defeats dragon... Prince gets defeated by princess...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Ugh. I thought I'd be able to find at least one story about mixology here, but nope! Just a bunch of fairytales.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait, here's one! Hmm, hero convinces dragon to defend kingdom by plying dragon with alcohol... Hah! What a load of baloney!
